title: Data Classification Report
description: Schema for the Data_Classification.md produced by Agente07_DevSecOps to classify all data entities handled by a feature.

entities.description: Classification of every data entity (table, field, or concept) handled by the feature.

entity_name.description: Name of the data entity (e.g., User.email, Task.title, prisma table name).

pii_fields.description: Specific PII fields within this entity.

regulatory_obligations.description: Specific regulatory obligations that apply (e.g., LGPD, GDPR, HIPAA).

highest_tier.description: The highest classification tier found across all entities. Controls the review depth.

restricted_human_signoff_required.description: True if any RESTRICTED entities were found — requires BLOCKED_PENDING_HUMAN.

human_signoff.description: Documentation of human sign-off for RESTRICTED data (if obtained).

privacy_review_required.description: True if CONFIDENTIAL or RESTRICTED entities found — triggers privacy-review-skill.
